workflow.hint.prepare.en: Set the audience and budget, then generate ads.
workflow.hint.prepare.zh: 设置受众和预算，然后生成广告。

workflow.hint.choose.en: Compare the ads and select the ones to test.
workflow.hint.choose.zh: 比较广告，选择要测试的广告。

workflow.hint.approveAds.en: Confirm the selected ads to lock their content.
workflow.hint.approveAds.zh: 确认所选广告，锁定内容。

workflow.hint.budget.en: Approve the budget for this campaign.
workflow.hint.budget.zh: 批准本次广告活动的预算。

workflow.hint.results.en: Compare performance and decide whether to test again.
workflow.hint.results.zh: 比较表现，决定是否继续测试。

workflow.overviewSub.en: Each campaign has one current step and one next action.
workflow.overviewSub.zh: 每个广告活动都有明确的当前步骤和下一步操作。

workflow.noGoal.en: Add your US launch goal in Company & accounts.
workflow.noGoal.zh: 在公司与账户中设置美国发行目标。

workflow.tasksSub.en: Action needed on {n} campaigns. Submitted campaigns appear last.
workflow.tasksSub.zh: {n} 个广告活动需要处理。已提交的活动排在最后。

workflow.noCampaigns.en: No campaigns yet. Choose a title from your catalog to start.
workflow.noCampaigns.zh: 暂无广告活动。请从剧库选择一部剧集开始。

workflow.nextTitlesSub.en: Suggestions from your catalog with no campaign yet.
workflow.nextTitlesSub.zh: 剧库中尚未创建广告活动的推荐作品。

workflow.readyTitle.zh: 已有视频 · 尚无广告活动

workflow.needsVideo.en: Upload video before starting a campaign
workflow.needsVideo.zh: 创建广告活动前需上传视频

workflow.noSuggestions.en: No additional titles to suggest. Review your catalog or add a title.
workflow.noSuggestions.zh: 暂无其他推荐作品，可查看剧库或新增作品。

workflow.setupSub.en: One-time setup and supporting records for your campaigns.
workflow.setupSub.zh: 广告活动所需的基础设置与参考记录。

workflow.setup.profileHint.en: Your launch goals and monthly budget.

workflow.setup.accountsHint.en: Record the connection status of your own account.
workflow.setup.accountsHint.zh: 记录自有账户的连接状态。

workflow.setup.reportsHint.en: Import your platform results when available.
workflow.setup.reportsHint.zh: 已有平台结果时，可导入报表。

workflow.campaignsSub.en: Each campaign is one test round for one drama. Open its next action to prepare ads, approve the round, or review results.
workflow.campaignsSub.zh: 每个广告活动对应一部剧的一轮测试。可准备广告、批准轮次或查看结果。

workflow.howItWorks.zh: 广告活动流程 · 6 个步骤

workflow.queueSub.en: One row per campaign. Tasks first, submitted campaigns last.
workflow.queueSub.zh: 每个广告活动一行。待办优先，已提交的排最后。

workflow.noTasks.en: No campaign needs your action right now. Submitted campaigns are waiting for results.
workflow.noTasks.zh: 目前没有需要处理的广告活动。已提交的活动正在等待结果。
